note.title: Identity and relationships with others
note.specFocus: Describing yourself and other people, families and different family structures, friendships, disagreements, reconciliation, and future relationships.
note.sourcePages: Original GCSE Spanish revision material; it is not an official AQA paper, mark scheme, or copied publisher content.
note.summary:
Identity and relationships with others

Key vocabulary
- la familia; los padres; el hermanastro/la hermanastra; llevarse bien/mal con; confiar en; apoyar; discutir; hacer las paces; fiel; cariñoso/a; generoso/a; de estatura media; el pelo rizado/liso

Key grammar
- Use ser for identity and character and estar for temporary states. Make adjectives agree. Contrast the preterite for completed actions with the imperfect for past habits and descriptions. Add opinions with porque/ya que and future or conditional verbs.

Exam tips
- Do not confuse me cae bien (I get on with) with me gusta. In listening and reading, check who is being described and watch for siempre, nunca and ya no.

questions.examTip: Build a short description, an opinion with porque and a personal or hypothetical comment.
questions.modelAnswer:
En la foto se ve una familia amplia que cocina y habla alrededor de una mesa. Las personas parecen concentradas y de buen humor. A mi parecer, esta situación es positiva porque muestra algo importante sobre tus relaciones personales, tu familia y tus amigos. Además, me gustaría participar porque sería una experiencia útil y memorable.

(English: In the photo I can see an extended family cooking and talking around a table. The people seem focused and in good spirits. In my opinion, this situation is positive because it shows something important about the topic. I would also like to take part because it would be useful and memorable.)
questions.question: Describe this photo showing an extended family cooking and talking around a table. Explain what the people are doing, make two reasonable inferences and give your own justified opinion about the topic.

questions.examTip: Cover all bullets and keep speaking; an opinion plus reason is better than a long but unfinished sentence.
questions.modelAnswer:
— Vivo con mis padres y mi hermana mayor en un piso pequeño. A mi modo de ver es importante porque tiene ventajas para mí y para otras personas. — (Unexpected question) El año pasado mis padres se mudaron y ahora mi tía vive más cerca.

(English: — I live with my parents and my older sister in a small flat. In my view it is important because it has benefits for me and other people. — Last year my parents moved and now my aunt lives nearer.)
questions.question: Role-play: your teacher plays a Spanish friend. Talk about tus relaciones personales, tu familia y tus amigos. You must: (1) say what you normally do or prefer, (2) explain your opinion and a reason, and (3) respond to the unexpected question: “What happened recently?”

questions.examTip: Cover all bullets and keep speaking; an opinion plus reason is better than a long but unfinished sentence.

(English: — I get on well with my cousin because he is fun and very sincere. In my view it is important because it has benefits for me and other people. — I cannot stand selfish people because they never help others.)
